description: Unit test class for OutboundMappingProcessor, testing message mapping, target grouping, enrichment, acknowledgment handling, message dropping, duplication, and failure scenarios in a messaging system.

classes.name: OutboundMappingProcessorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for OutboundMappingProcessor, testing various aspects of message processing, mapping, target grouping, enrichment, acknowledgments, and failure handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes static resources, such as ActorSystem, logging, and configuration for all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests are run.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the OutboundMappingProcessor instance with default configurations and mappings before each test.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageMapped
methods.description: Tests that an outbound message with a specific mapping is processed and sent correctly.

methods.name: testOutboundResponseMapped
methods.description: Tests handling of outbound response message mapping.

methods.name: testGroupingOfTargets
methods.description: Verifies that target grouping reduces number of messages based on shared mappers.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageEnriched
methods.description: Checks message enrichment functionality by verifying extra data in the payload.

methods.name: testOutboundEventWithRequestedAcksWhichAreIssuedByTargetDontContainRequestedAcks
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment inclusion when targets issue acknowledgements that are different from the request.

methods.name: testOutboundLiveMessageWithRequestedAcksWhichAreIssuedByTargetDontContainRequestedAcks
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment handling with live messages and target-issued acknowledgements.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageDropped
methods.description: Ensures messages flagged to drop are not sent.

methods.name: testOutboundMappingFails
methods.description: Simulates mapping failure and verifies error handling.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageDroppedFailedMappedDuplicated
methods.description: Tests a complex scenario with drops, errors, mapping failures, and duplication.

methods.description: Helper method to create a target with specified payload mappings.

methods.description: Test helper that performs outbound processing and verifies outcomes.
